record.title: Correct the existing eight-byte timestamp preservation check
record.intent: Preserve the original calibration contract while fixing a mis-sized time-field comparator.
requirements: Preserve the partial stock transition and independently pin the stock checked-stream writer, existing record inspector and actual archive delta. Prove the timestamp extent from implementation rather than accepting an unexplained changed byte.

Correct only the comparator for the already established eight-byte time field at file bytes12 through19 and its dependent header CRC. Retain exact header version/length fields, payloadCRC, byte-identical320byte coefficients, protected inventory/licenses and existing172byte fallback allowance. No calibration or specimen file write is admitted.

Prepare a distinct read-only stock continuation tied to the actual postboot process and verified captured86400second lease. It may read baseline state, observe visible UI, service greater1800seconds warmup and run one16byte stock observer; it must contain no native transition or reboot action.

Verify physical gates, observer lifetime, current process binding, local output layout, lease/deadline reserves and graceful recorder handling with bounded offline controls and independent review. Commit and push preparation before any continuation contact.
acceptance: Pinned time-field evidence and tested unchanged preservation intent support one read-only stock continuation or a hold.
